title: Independent coordinate resampling kernel
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number, let $\rho\in[0,1]$, and let $x\in\{\pm1\}^n$. Define a probability distribution on $\{\pm1\}^n$ by independently retaining each coordinate of $x$ with probability $\rho$ and otherwise replacing it by an independent uniform sign.
